scenario: Schema slot with unknown type is rejected at compile time per LGRA.5.1 / LGRA.5.7. Field types are restricted to `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, `String`, `Json`, `Bytes`, and temporal types. An unrecognised type name rejects with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_TYPE.
